§6Aluminium§f

§aLight, soft, and absolutely everywhere in your future.§f

Aluminium ore spawns between Y 5 and 45. Smelt it directly, or process bauxite for better yields. Powdered aluminium is used in thermite, so keep some on hand.

The real value: §bfireclay§f (clay + aluminium → firebricks for the crucible), §bfluid ducts§f for transporting fluids, §bgunmetal§f (aluminium + red copper in the rotary furnace), and §baluminium plates§f for arc welding.

You'll burn through aluminium fast once you start building foundry infrastructure. It's also used in low-density element storage and liquid containers. Stockpile it.

§ePS:§f Bauxite ore drops aluminium directly when processed.
